In this role, you will support the monthly revenue close process, assist with revenue accounting operations, and partner closely with stakeholders to ensure accurate revenue recognition and reporting. This role reports to the Director of Revenue Accounting and will support ongoing operational and process improvement initiatives as Highspot continues to scale.
